segments.name: Connected Technology Solutions
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells dental technology and equipment products, including imaging, treatment centers and CAD/CAM systems, for dental practitioners and specialists.
segments.evidence: This segment includes the design, manufacture and sales of the Company's dental technology and equipment products.

segments.name: Essential Dental Solutions
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and sells endodontic, restorative and preventive consumable products and small equipment used by dental professionals to treat patients.
segments.evidence: This segment includes the development, manufacture and sales of the Company's value-added endodontic, restorative, and preventive consumable products and small equipment used by dental professionals for the treatment of patients.

segments.name: Orthodontic and Implant Solutions
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells digital implant systems, dental implants, digital dentures and digital orthodontic solutions supported by the DS Core cloud platform.
segments.evidence: This segment includes the design, manufacture, and sales of the Company's various digital implant systems and innovative dental implant products, digital dentures, and digital orthodontic solutions.

segments.name: Wellspect Healthcare
segments.description: Designs, manufactures and sells continence care solutions for urinary and bowel management, serving people with urinary retention and chronic constipation.
segments.evidence: This segment includes the design, manufacture, and sales of the Company's innovative continence care solutions for both urinary and bowel management.
